data.title: 大凤 · 私密保健室的贴身诊疗
data.description: 【大凤 · 私密保健室的贴身诊疗】拉紧遮光帘的港区医务室诊查床前，大凤身穿粉色紧身护士超短裙，领口敞开露出惹火深沟。她将银色的听诊器贴在指挥官心口处，自己饱满柔软的巨乳却有意无意地压在对方的手臂上。她吐气如兰地贴近耳畔轻语——「指挥官大人的心跳……好快呢。是不是因为只有大凤在身边而感到兴奋了呢？」
data.location: 港区医务室病床遮帘内
data.action: 手持听诊器探身贴近，护士裙领口大敞，巨乳贴近指挥官手臂，眼神迷离
data.lighting: 白布帘过滤出的柔和苍白冷光与肌肤粉红暖色
data.camera: medium close-up, pov angle, extreme physical proximity
data.promptProse: Taihou leans beside the port infirmary examination bed in her pink nurse dress, cap and white stockings, setting a silver stethoscope against the Commander's chest and speaking close to their ear. The first-person medium close-up keeps the instrument and steady contact visible with the privacy curtain behind. Pale light filtered through its white fabric softens her face and uniform, catching the stethoscope rim above the shaded bed edge.
